dedupe_keys.name: ran and nwdaf combined data from cellular network

description: The University of Catania publishes combined radio-access-network and user-equipment metrics from four base stations at Piazza Duomo in Catania, Italy. The December 2023 Zenodo record supplies combined_data.csv under CC BY 4.0. The deposited description identifies machine-learning studies of physical-resource-block allocation in O-RAN as its intended use, with throughput and delay among the performance measures of interest. The metrics could support radio-resource allocation experiments or observation models within cellular-network simulations. Collection dates, time resolution, column definitions, units and anonymisation details remain unknown from the short public summary. Four base stations in one urban setting do not establish performance across the wider network. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this collection. The CSV was not downloaded and no allocation method was trained or evaluated.
